recipes.name: Chocolate Bliss Cheesecake
ingredients_raw: 18 OREO Chocolate Sandwich Cookies, finely crushed
3 (8 ounce) packages PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
8 (1 ounce) squares BAKER'S Semi-Sweet Baking Chocolate, melted, cooled slightly

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F/165 degrees C (if using a silver 9-inch springform pan) or to 300 degrees F/150 degrees C (if using a dark nonstick 9-inch springform pan).
Combine cookie crumbs and butter. Mix until evenly moistened; press firmly into the bottom of 9-inch springform pan.

Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla together in large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add melted chocolate; beat well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating on low speed after each addition just until blended. Pour over crust.

Bake in the preheated oven until center is almost set, 55 to 60 minutes. Run the tip of a knife or metal spatula around the edges of the pan to loosen cake; cool before removing sides of pan. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Store leftover cheesecake in refrigerator.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate Bliss Cheesecake
raw_recipe.description: Garnish this indulgent chocolate cheesecake with fresh raspberries.

review.reviewBody: This is so good! The right texture, great flavor...yum!

I originally got this recipe out of a recipe book and later found out it's on the bakers package of the chocolate squares. So I decided to search and see if it was on allrecipes, which it is. This recipe is easy! I am having a new years after party at my house and am going to have a lot of guests so I decided to make a this, except I didn't bake this in a springform pan but in a muffin pan with liners because slicing a large cheesecake is a lot of work and it ruins the presentation. It came out NICE! This recipe came out for exactly 2 muffin pans all I did was pat down a tablespoon of the crumb mixture onto each muffin liner and a large dab of the cheesecake mixture and now I have a serving of 24 instead of 12! What a fabulous dessert! Can't wait to entertain my guests!
Love this chocolate cheesecake. It is delicious. Use a food processor and the texture is amazing. Use a good quality chocolate too.
It was a little dry. Next time I will cook it 5 minutes less.
Easy and fabulous! I recommend that you make this the day before serving. The flavors were incredible and yummy the next day for the last two pieces left.

I'm not a good baker, but this was super easy to make! I also made a few tweaks: I used a non-dairy cream cheese; I added a bit more vanilla (maybe about 1/2 tsp); added about 1/4 cup of cocoa powder; and a bit of... (sorry, can't give up this little secret! ) It turned out great! Even my husband liked it, and he's not much of a cheesecake guy!
My family loved this At Christmas and voted I have to make it every year. Easy recipe few ingredients nice and easy. The best chocolate cheesecake ever.
Wow very good! Tastes awesome, super easy to make.
Very easy to make and it turned out delicious.
I have made this cheesecake for years! I took it it to another level by covering it with chocolate Ganache, oh my ,oh my, heavenly
Very yummy. Very rich. Mine did not look this pretty. The top did crack and sink in the middle a bit. Covered the top with raspberry sauce and nobody knew any different.
really yummmyyyy i did it with graham cookie crust it come out really good
I am a very experienced baker, having made many cheesecakes. I did not care for this recipe. It is dry and unappealing.
Family favorite now. The only thing I change is purchasing an already prepared chocolate pie crust instead of the Oreo's & butter.
